And anyways, I am 99% certain that AI cannot create better than the best creators if you dont think they already cant create better than the "lowest quality" creators. What does the term "good" mean to you? I mean, many people I guess have their own definitions of it, but ultimately I believe something that is of awesome quality has to have style, and to have genuine, cohesive, and real style it has to have a little humanity in it, otherwise our senses dont pick it up as natural. I could ask AI to create the best, most PERFECT piece of art, better than Picasso, or ask AI to make a music piece better than Beethoven (not saying they were the BEST creators in those subjects in the whole world by the way). Do you, do people who support this WANT the future to be AI leeching off our creativity, making us work for them, whilst still following dead instructions from a dead time without purpose (sounds schizophrenic I know, thats how absurd the future is looking to be). 

Using AI with fucking therapy, GOD NO. I PRAY THAT WE CAN BOTH AGREE THAT THAT IS BAD.
